payload.reason: The evidence provides detailed descriptions of various baseline models used in the study, including vanilla ST, pre-training, and multi-task baselines.

claims.text: The baselines include a vanilla ST model, pre-training models (encoder, decoder, and encoder-decoder pre-training), and multi-task models (one-to-many, many-to-one, many-to-many).
The pre-training baselines utilize ASR and MT models for initialization, enhancing performance in speech translation tasks.
Multi-task baselines are tested in various settings, showing different configurations of training parameters for optimal performance.
